weight_function.description: Which function produces IpAttributes.weight at transition time (spec section 46, ADR-0005). Default "threshold_ratio". Adding a function is an enum entry plus a spec section 46 definition; the wire format does not change, because weight is always a fixed-point integer in thousandths of hot_threshold.

weight_max.description: Upper clamp applied to weight, in the same thousandths-of-hot_threshold units (1000 = exactly at hot_threshold). Default 1000000. Bounds what an extreme window count can write into a per-IP record.
